recognize_zh: 此圖並非一般 Wright 染色：多數大型顆粒球系細胞（核呈帶狀、分葉或腎形）胞質為灰藍色，無明顯紅色陽性顆粒，周邊則有紫紅色團塊；推測是細胞化學染色（可能為白血球鹼性磷酸酶 LAP），若是 LAP，大部分顆粒球不染即符合 CML 的低 LAP 分數，但圖上未標示染色方法。
features: Non-Romanowsky cytochemical-type stain with blue counterstained cells and magenta-red deposits
Numerous granulocytic cells (metamyelocytes, band and segmented forms) with lobulated, reniform or band nuclei
Most granulocytes show gray-blue cytoplasm without distinct red reaction granules
Magenta-red staining clumps at the periphery of the field, possibly positive cells or background material
Occasional smaller cells with dense nuclei; resolution limits granule assessment
describe_en: Smear stained with what appears to be a cytochemical method shows numerous maturing granulocytic cells, including metamyelocytes, bands and segmented forms, most of which lack distinct red reaction product in the cytoplasm. Magenta-red deposits are present at the periphery of the field but cannot be confidently assigned to individual cells. The specific stain is not labeled; if this is a leukocyte alkaline phosphatase stain, the predominance of non-reactive neutrophils would indicate a low LAP score, consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia. Because the stain type and scoring cannot be verified from this image, BCR::ABL1 testing remains the definitive study.

ddx.vs: A leukemoid reaction shows a high LAP score with strongly reactive neutrophils, toxic granulation and no basophilia or BCR::ABL1 fusion.
These MPNs typically have normal to increased LAP scores and carry JAK2, CALR or MPL mutations rather than BCR::ABL1.
PNH also shows a low LAP score, but presents with hemolysis and absent GPI-anchored proteins on flow cytometry rather than a left-shifted leukocytosis.
